## New

- View battery levels for supported AM Infinity mice and receivers directly
  from the macOS menu bar.
- Connect over wired USB, Bluetooth, or a 2.4 GHz receiver with automatic
  connection priority.
- Publish USB-backed battery sources to the built-in macOS Batteries widget.
- Optionally launch Infinity Hub automatically when you sign in.

## Improvements

- Group a paired mouse and receiver into one compact, divided card.
- Keep multiple device groups easy to distinguish with compact product
  headers and stable ordering.
- Retain the last wireless mouse battery reading for up to five minutes during
  brief sleep or reconnect periods.
- Hide disconnected wired devices immediately and show an empty state when no
  devices remain.

## Installation

Download the signed and notarized ZIP from this release, extract it, and move Infinity Hub to Applications.
